description: This file defines a Qt6 application that creates a simple welcome window with styled labels using Qt's widget and layout classes. It includes the implementation of the WelcomeWidget constructor and the main function that initializes and runs the application.

classes.name: WelcomeWidget
classes.description: A QWidget subclass that constructs a welcome message interface with styled labels displayed in a vertical layout.

methods.name: WelcomeWidget::WelcomeWidget
methods.description: Constructor that sets up the layout, labels, styles, and window properties for the welcome widget.

methods.name: int main(int argc,char * argv[])
methods.description: The entry point of the application that initializes QApplication, creates the WelcomeWidget, and starts the event loop.
